propositions: divergent_implementation is mis-calibrated: fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings despite being the only hard-override axis never calibrated with worked examples or a closed Literal grade set
the axis is graded none 90% of the time within its intended domain class (omitted scope sites), causing 770 of those findings to score impact exactly 0.0 despite describing real plan-code divergence

replacing ordinal grades (none|low|medium|high) with a closed Literal set of divergence kinds (contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration, none) with semantic-based flooring is required to restore firing precision without over-blocking

the four structural changes to impact_plan (new DIVERGENCE_GRADE01 map, _DIVERGENCE_FLOOR_GRADES membership test, _PLAN_GRADED_AXES driver list, and exclusion from _SEV01 loop) are necessary because a schema-only change would score all new grades as 0.0 and stop the axis firing entirely

a prod_impact floor (Fix 2) is rejected because it unlocks unbounded severity-based findings that cannot be remedied by plan edits, colliding with the novelty convergence floor and destabilizing the remediation loop, whereas the divergence-graded approach (Fix 1) targets semantically bounded remediable classes

ADR 0054 must reject purpose-built LLM calibration suites and bulk re-reviews, narrowing ADR 0036's A/B clause to corpus replay and dogfooding only, because calibration must be driven by version-tagged sidecar data already produced during normal gate operation
